title: CAPTF contract v1alpha1: cluster role outputs
description: The cluster role's root outputs as decoded from state (common.md, cluster.md). Every contract output must be declared; null means "not yet known" (README.md "Null semantics"). Extra, non-contract outputs are allowed and ignored.

control_plane_endpoint.description: Written to TerraformCluster.spec.controlPlaneEndpoint once valid; must stay stable for the life of the object.

failure_domains.description: TerraformCluster.status.failureDomains; null and [] both clear the field. At most 100 entries (MaxItems=100).

exports.description: Any value (object recommended), injected verbatim into machine/pool modules as captf_cluster_outputs; null is treated as {}.
